description: This file contains utility extension functions for Android Views and related UI components, such as focus management, keyboard handling, app bar elevation on scroll, text ellipsizing, and drawer behavior.

methods.name: dp
methods.description: Converts an integer value in density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on the device's display density.

methods.name: requestFocusAndKeyboard
methods.description: Requests focus on the view and shows the soft keyboard, handling focus change and window focus events to trigger keyboard display.

methods.name: showKeyboard
methods.description: Displays the soft keyboard for the view.

methods.name: hideKeyboard
methods.description: Hides the soft keyboard associated with the view.

methods.name: liftAppBarOnScroll
methods.description: Adjusts the elevation of an AppBarLayout when the attached scrollable view is scrolled vertically to provide a lift effect.

methods.name: ellipsize
methods.description: Automatically truncates the text in a TextView with ellipsis if it exceeds the maximum number of lines, appending '...'.

methods.name: closeAndThen
methods.description: Closes the DrawerLayout and then executes a callback function after the drawer is fully closed.
